title: analyzing-opencode-usage bug fixes plan
purpose: Create implementation plan for 12 bugs in the analyzing-opencode-usage skill
outcome: Wrote comprehensive bug fix plan covering 12 bugs in 3 phases with Given-When-Then scenarios, specific file paths, code changes, and success criteria
key_decisions: Phased approach: P0 data correctness (B1/B10/B2/B3/B5), P1 structural (B4/B6/B8/B9), P2 maintenance (B7/B11/B12)
Phases return empty list instead of configurable CLI — deferring to future feature plan
Build sessions approximated via token ratio since per-category session counts don't exist in daily_tokens
Cost unified to per-model rates as primary, flat rates kept for backward compatibility
CTE extraction in cache_estimate.py reduces ~200 lines to ~40 lines of shared logic
learnings: generate_report.py calls resolve_date twice — once in main() and once in fetch_all_datasets() — with days=args.days still set, potentially overriding already-resolved dates
summary_files column in opencode DB is always 0 — productivity.py SQL referencing it is dead code
daily_agent_stacked and timeseries sharing the same list is documented as 'intentional' but is a mutation hazard
cost_summary omits reasoning_tokens entirely — silently excluding reasoning token costs from display
productive_build_sessions sums total sessions on commit dates, not build-category sessions — a subset can exceed its superset
next_steps: Review plan with stakeholder for approval
Hand off to build-tdd for Phase 1 implementation
